discovery-weak-signals.name: Developer-to-network platform convergence
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Owning widely used build tooling can reduce friction from development through deployment while security capabilities broaden enterprise relevance.

expectations-execution.name: Growth versus cost reset
expectations-execution.basis: Demand indicators remain strong while margin compression and restructuring make the quality/cost of growth a live execution question.

items.risk: Developer/network platform convergence is substitutable by hyperscaler-native stacks and specialist security/developer vendors.
Post-restructuring margin improvement may fail to offset infrastructure and platform-integration costs.
Convertible financing can create future dilution and raises the bar for productive capital deployment.
Platform breadth does not guarantee monetization and integration can increase operating complexity.
Gross-margin compression and restructuring can offset strong top-line growth if efficiency gains do not materialize.
GAAP operating loss materially widened despite strong revenue growth, so margin quality and stock-based/other expense structure remain important underwriting checks.

Early-access AI security capability may not translate into broad paid adoption, durable differentiation or attractive unit economics; reliance on a model partner also adds an external technology dependency.
